text: Before a visit day, take two minutes to read your schedule.
Home opens on the practice calendar. Pick yourself under Primary Provider.
The one thing to remember: check your day the evening before: the arrival windows, the drive, and anything flagged.
Week view shows each day's points and drive time at a glance.
Day view shows one day in detail.
Each card shows the arrival window the family was promised.
View appointment has the reason for the visit, the family's phone and address.
ETA is when routing expects you. Window is what the family was told.
Maps opens the day's route in Google Maps, stop by stop, from the depot and back.
The printer icon downloads My Day as a PDF, for paper or a tablet.
A red RL means the family hasn't done their Room Loader yet. Know before you go.

The most common mistakes: reading the start time instead of the window, and finding out about a missing Room Loader in the driveway. Remember: check your day the evening before: the arrival windows, the drive, and anything flagged.
